test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'You can add' is coded as 'cb ns pd',

'add their money' is coded as 'io uv cb',

'their bank can' is coded as 'km uv pd'.

(Note: All codes are two letter codes only)

What is the probable code for 'money bank' in the given code language?
solution:
The code for each word is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8ea6dd33683f6a7f64112cb2b21123a8e860b93fcb5ca6d498b757f2aa219c7.png] 

Code for:

money - io

bank - km

Hence, ‘**km io**’ is the correct answer.
